componentExceptions.reason: SQLite is dedicated to the public domain (the SQLite Blessing) and carries no SPDX identifier, so cargo/libsqlite3-sys records no licence and the SBOM has no licence node. Public-domain is compatible with the AGPL-3.0-only outbound licence. Keyed by the version-independent purl because the public-domain status is invariant across libsqlite3-sys versions.

rayon-core 1.13.0 (MIT OR Apache-2.0) declares links = "rayon-core" solely as a single-version marker; it compiles no native library. The derived native component has no separate licence beyond the crate's MIT OR Apache-2.0 licence, compatible with AGPL-3.0-only. Keyed by the version-independent purl to match the SBOM's links-derived identity.
